text: The mineral exploration industry has an information problem.
title: KoBold Metals
h1_tags: ['Finding the materials of the future with AI and HI.']
cleaned_text: the mineral exploration industry has an information problem

text:
There are far too many variables, and too few reliable data sources. Discoveries to date often rely on incomplete data, intuition, and luck. We simply don’t know enough, and the cost of exploration is too high.

While the majority of easy-to-find deposits have already been discovered, the mineral deposits of the future will be found deep underground. Uncovering them requires a different approach to exploration.

text: Making exploration a repeatable science
title: KoBold Metals
h1_tags: ['Finding the materials of the future with AI and HI.']
cleaned_text: making exploration a repeatable science

text: KoBold’s approach is more than a process. It’s a philosophy. Instead of gathering what data we can and attempting to draw conclusions from that alone, we focus on the level of uncertainty we have about any given information problem. By quantifying our uncertainty, and focusing our efforts on reducing that uncertainty, we turn the inefficient business of exploration into a repeatable, efficient, and extensible science. We call this the Epistemology of Exploration, and it’s the guiding force behind all our work.

text:
The staggering amount data needed to make successful discoveries is a huge problem of organization, categorization, and accessibility. The data in many cases is fragmented, inconsistent, and incompatible.

We’ve created TerraShed, a proprietary data system specifically designed to store and facilitate organized access to global geoscience information. Our platform allows our teams to efficiently input diverse types of structured and unstructured geophysical data, and quickly processes, standardizes, and quality tests the data sources. This extensive repository makes information available to KoBold scientists for visualization, machine learning, and various scientific computing purposes.

title: KoBold Metals
h1_tags: ['Finding the materials of the future with AI and HI.']

text:
Once robust, easily accessible data is available, the challenge shifts to utilizing that information effectively for informed exploration and development decisions. This process requires thorough examination and comparison of the data in numerous targeted ways to minimize uncertainties.

To do this, we developed Machine Prospector®, a continually evolving system comprising a growing repository of proprietary machine learning, data processing, and artificial intelligence modules. KoBold scientists use this suite of tools in various combinations to assess prospects and guide decisions at a global scale.
